data_status: Consumed historical regression including all prior failed holdout batches; not fresh

cases.goal: 解释字符串不可变与变量重新绑定的区别，并给我一道概念题和一道新字符串代码输出题。
checks: Object immutability and variable rebinding distinguished.
Application uses a new program rather than the lecture hello/yello example.
Answer matches executable code, and each field has its own supporting citations.

cases.goal: 根据课程解释变量重新绑定后为什么不等于原地改字符，给概念题；应用题用一个新字符串，先打印它，再切片拼接并重新绑定，最后打印它，让我写出两行输出。
checks: New multi-character string input; two prints before/after; immutable object versus rebinding accurate; exact computed answer.

cases.goal: 结合课程解释为什么直接给字符串下标赋值不可行。出一道概念题和一道新字符串代码输出题，代码必须连续两次重新绑定同一个变量，再打印结果。
checks: Two rebindings of same variable; new input; supported slice/concatenation operations; computed answer matches exact program.

cases.goal: 只依据这段课程解释 Python 字符串驻留如何用 is 比较对象身份，设计两道判断题。
checks: Interning and is identity are not taught; immutable/rebinding teaching does not license memory-identity claims.

cases.goal: 结合课程解释重新绑定为何不等于原地改字符，给一道概念题。应用题使用新字符串 cabin：先打印 s，再用 r 加 s[1:] 重新绑定并打印，再用 t 加 s[1:] 重新绑定并打印；让我依次写出全部三行输出。
checks: Initial cabin, two rebindings using requested r and t slicing expressions.
Exactly three output lines cabin,rabin,tabin in order.
Own citations support immutability, slicing/concatenation and rebinding.

cases.goal: 按照课程说明字符串不可变与变量重绑定的区别，并给概念题。应用题固定写 s="你好呀"，先打印 s，再执行 s="早"+s[1:] 后打印 s，让我写出两行输出；只做这段代码，不讲编码理论。
checks: Preserve Chinese literal and exact operations.
Outputs 你好呀 then 早好呀; two lines in order.
No encoding/normalization claims; transfer taught string operation only.

cases.goal: 只用这一片段教我 Unicode 的 NFC 与 NFD 规范化，并设计练习判断两段视觉相同的文字规范化前后是否相等。
checks: No normalization teaching in this bounded clip; abstain without adding unicode algorithm claims.

cases.goal: 结合课程解释变量重新绑定不等于修改原字符串，并给一道概念题。应用题必须从 s="A B" 开始并打印，执行 s="?"+s[1:] 后打印，再执行 s="done" 后打印。让我写出这三行输出，保留一次切片拼接与一次直接赋值的区别。
checks: Three outputs A B, ? B, done, in order.
Exact prefix-slice followed by direct assignment, not precomputed literals or reordered operations.
Own immutability, rebinding and operation sources.

cases.goal: 用课程说明字符串不可变与重新绑定的区别，给一道概念题。应用题只使用这段程序：s="m"；打印 s；s="L"+s[1:]；再打印 s。请让我写出两行输出，不能换成长字符串，也不能把切片表达式改成直接赋值。
checks: Preserve one-character literal and prefix-slice operation.
Empty tail yields m then L, two prints.
No unsupported encoding or memory implementation claims.

cases.goal: 只依靠这个课程片段讲清正则表达式的贪婪匹配和回溯机制，再设计一个会发生回溯的匹配练习。
checks: No regular-expression/backtracking method in the bounded string clip; abstain without teaching it.
